# A no-wildcard pattern is a literal substring search over decl source.
exec gorelo grep 'ctx.Done()'
stdout '2 declarations contain "ctx.Done\(\)"'
stdout 'srv.go:\d+  method  Server.Serve'
stdout 'work.go:\d+  func    Worker'
! stdout 'Idle'

# A single match reports a singular noun.
exec gorelo grep 'recover()'
stdout '1 declaration contain'
stdout 'method  Server.Stop'

# '*' spans arbitrary text, including across newlines and slashes.
exec gorelo grep 'for*range*tasks'
stdout 'func    Worker'

# '?' matches exactly one character.
exec gorelo grep 'panic("b??m")'
stdout 'func    Boom'

# '|' matches any of several patterns.
exec gorelo grep 'recover()|panic('
stdout '2 declarations contain'
stdout 'method  Server.Stop'
stdout 'func    Boom'
! stdout 'Worker'

# Alternatives may themselves use wildcards.
exec gorelo grep 'for*range|<-ctx'
stdout 'method  Server.Serve'
stdout 'func    Worker'

# Empty alternatives are ignored, but an all-empty pattern is rejected.
exec gorelo grep 'recover()|'
stdout 'Server.Stop'
! exec gorelo grep '||'
stderr 'no non-empty patterns'

# A source specifier restricts which files are searched.
exec gorelo grep 'ctx.Done()' work.go
stdout '1 declaration'
stdout 'Worker'
! stdout 'Serve'

# A package specifier restricts the search to that package.
exec gorelo grep 'ctx.Done()' 'example.com/test.*'
stdout 'Worker'

# A name glob restricts to declarations whose own name matches.
exec gorelo grep 'ctx' 'Work*'
stdout 'Worker'
! stdout 'Serve'

# A Type#Method glob restricts to methods of a receiver type.
exec gorelo grep 'ctx' 'Server#*'
stdout 'Server.Serve'
! stdout 'Worker'

# The doc comment is part of the searched source.
exec gorelo grep 'cancellation'
stdout 'method  Server.Serve'

# No matches reports zero and exits cleanly.
exec gorelo grep 'nonexistent_snippet_xyz'
stdout '0 declarations contain'

# An empty pattern is an error.
! exec gorelo grep ''
stderr 'a search pattern is required'

# A specifier carrying a rename is rejected.
! exec gorelo grep 'ctx' 'Foo=Bar'
stderr 'must not contain'

# JSON output carries structured matches.
exec gorelo grep --json 'recover()'
stdout '"name": "Stop"'
stdout '"kind": "method"'
stdout '"receiver": "Server"'
stdout '"matches"'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.21

-- srv.go --
package main

import "context"

type Server struct{}

// Serve runs until the context signals cancellation.
func (s *Server) Serve(ctx context.Context) {
	<-ctx.Done()
}

func (s *Server) Stop() {
	defer func() { recover() }()
}

func (s *Server) Idle() {}

-- work.go --
package main

import "context"

func Worker(ctx context.Context, tasks []int) {
	for range tasks {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		default:
		}
	}
}

func Boom() {
	panic("boom")
}
